title: sm_86 cohort regeneration ledger
description: Per-cell audit artifact for the sm_86 cohort regeneration workflow. Each entry covers one sm_86 cell from data/local_labels/label_admitted.json with the 6-tuple identity key (arch, slug, shape_point, binary_sha256, kernel_signature_sha256, label_source_commit), a closed-enum terminal status, and the regen-artifact paths emitted by the per-cell pipeline (binary rebuild -> NVBit trace -> sidecar production -> bundle cascade). The artifact lives at data/local_labels/sm86_cohort_regen_ledger.json. The status enum is closed (admitted plus 9 typed-failure categories); a status outside the enum is rejected at parse time. Consistency arms: admitted entries MUST carry non-null binary_path / trace_dir / predictor_bundle_path / sidecar_paths; excluded_* entries MUST carry a typed_reason. The schema validates against draft-2020-12.

generated_at_utc.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp recording when the producer emitted this artifact.

source_commit.description: Git commit SHA-1 of the producer code that emitted this artifact.

host_arch.description: The host architecture the regen workflow runs against. Currently sm_86 only; future cross-arch ledgers may widen this enum in lockstep with a schema_version bump.

n_cells.description: The number of sm_86 cells covered by this ledger. Must equal len(cells).

cells.description: One entry per sm_86 cell in data/local_labels/label_admitted.json. Coverage is enforced by tools/local_labels/test_sm86_cohort_regen_ledger_coverage.py.

binary_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the per-slug binary the cell binds to. Matches label_admitted.json verbatim per the strict-equality identity contract for predictor bundles (every emitted bundle's manifest_pairing_index 5-tuple must match the admitted label byte-for-byte).

register_cap.description: Optional register-cap build-variant axis value (per-thread -maxrregcount cap). Purely additive: NOT in 'required'; base cells omit it and remain valid. Present only for build-variant entries and paired with variant_id. Mirrors the local_label_admitted.schema.json register_cap field. No schema_version bump (purely additive per the CLAUDE.md wire-extension policy).

variant_id.description: Optional build-variant identity component of the cell key (e.g. register_cap_64). Purely additive: NOT in 'required'; base cells omit it. When present it widens the ledger cell identity from (arch, slug, shape_point) to (arch, slug, shape_point, variant_id) so two build variants of the same shape are distinct admitted ledger entries. Paired with register_cap; the pattern pins the canonical decimal form (no leading zeros). Mirrors the local_label_admitted.schema.json variant_id field. No schema_version bump (purely additive per the CLAUDE.md wire-extension policy).

label_source_commit.description: The source_commit recorded on the cell's row in label_admitted.json. Pins the label provenance independently of producer_commit.

status.description: Closed terminal status. admitted: all regen artifacts present, schema-valid, identity-bound. rebuild_binary_failed: per-slug binary could not be rebuilt (typed_reason names the build error). trace_failed: NVBit dynamic_trace.pb not produced for this cell. sidecar_failed: one of the sharing_locality / hrd_profile / sector_stream sidecars failed schema or manifest-pairing-index validation. bundle_failed: bundle cascade rejected every candidate. schema_invalid: an emitted artifact failed its offline schema validator. identity_mismatch: a downstream artifact's identity 5-tuple drifted from the label. trace_volume_exceeded / slowdown_budget_exceeded / drop_rate_exceeded: NVBit trace runtime caps fired.

typed_reason.description: Required when status != admitted; names the load-bearing sub-cause (e.g., arch_gate_excludes_sm_86, dynamic_trace_pb_absent_post_relabel, sharing_locality_mpi_mismatch). MUST be null when status=admitted.

binary_path.description: Repo-relative path to the per-slug binary. Required when status=admitted; may be null when status indicates the binary is absent.

trace_dir.description: Repo-relative path to the NVBit trace directory containing dynamic_trace.pb. Required when status=admitted.

predictor_bundle_path.description: Repo-relative path to the admitted predictor bundle JSON. Required when status=admitted.

bundle_admission_path.description: Closed-enum classification of which admission path produced the admitted predictor bundle. legacy_match: the bundle was found under an existing sweep root (e.g., data/local_labels/sweeps/sweep_<timestamp>_<hash>/predictor_bundles/...). fresh_regen: the bundle was emitted into the current loop's fresh-regen output path (data/local_labels/sweeps/sm86_cohort_regen_<UTC>/comparison/predictor_bundles/...). Required-non-null when status=admitted; must be null for every non-admitted status.

sector_stream_mpi.description: Repo-relative path to the sector_stream/manifest_pairing_index.json sibling that pins the bundle-identity binding. Required when status=admitted alongside the other primary sidecars.

divergence_proxies.description: Repo-relative path to the divergence_proxies/divergence_proxies.json sidecar produced by tools/divergence_proxies/bundle_from_trace.py::consume_trace_dir. Required when status=admitted alongside the other primary sidecars.

order_projections.description: Repo-relative path to the order_projections/order_projections.json sidecar produced by tools/order_projections/projector.py::compute_order_projections. Required when status=admitted alongside the other primary sidecars.

sidecar_paths.description: Repo-relative paths to the five primary task4 sidecars (sharing_locality, hrd_profile, sector_stream, divergence_proxies, order_projections) plus the sector_stream manifest-pairing-index sibling. Required when status=admitted; the inner fields are individually required-non-null in that arm. The five primary sidecars mirror the original task4 producer inventory in plans/sm86_cohort_regen_3090ti_plan.md.

attempted_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when the producer last evaluated this cell's regen state.

producer_commit.description: Git commit SHA-1 of the producer code that emitted this entry.

artifact_sha256.description: Per-artifact SHA-256 digests for admitted cells. Required-non-null inner fields when status=admitted; may be null when the artifact is absent. Covers the eight audited artifacts: predictor bundle, dynamic trace pb, and the six task4 sidecars (sharing_locality, hrd_profile, sector_stream + MPI sibling, divergence_proxies, order_projections).

validator_status.description: The outcome of the offline schema validator run against the emitted artifacts. not_run is allowed when status != admitted (the validator could not be invoked because the prerequisite artifacts are absent).

live_evidence_status.description: CLAUDE.md-defined evidence status for the cell's regen work. Verified-live-sm_86 means the NCU label that admits this cell into the cohort was captured live on a sm_86 host. Cross-arch-verified requires both a Verified-live-sm_86 and a Verified-live-sm_120 evidence anchor for the same cell, typically across two consecutive sessions on alternating devices. The Verified-live-sm_120 value is intentionally excluded from this sm_86 ledger; a future cross-arch ledger covering sm_120 cells will live in a sibling artifact.

allOf.description: admitted-status arm: all artifact path fields MUST be non-null.
excluded-status arm: typed_reason MUST be a non-empty string AND bundle_admission_path MUST be null (admission paths only apply to admitted rows).
